visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up, high-definition shot of sliced Hong Kong-style Shao Shing Char Siu pork resting on a bed of cooked Napa cabbage, garnished with fresh cilantro. The meat has a dark, glossy glaze and visible fat marbling. (2) The camera zooms in further on the meat, highlighting the juice and sauce dripping from the slices. (3) A shot shows a slice of the pork being lifted with dark wooden chopsticks, revealing a cross-section with a slightly crispy outer edge and tender, moist fibers. (4) Transition to a preparation phase where hands wearing clear gloves place a large piece of raw pork neck in a clear glass bowl and use a fork to prick holes into it. The setting is a brightly lit studio kitchen. (5) Various sauces and chopped ingredients like garlic and ginger are poured onto the meat. Yellow text overlays indicate the specific measurements. (6) The gloved hands thoroughly massage the seasonings and fermented red bean curd into the pork until it is completely coated in a dark red marinade. (7) The scene shifts to a black frying pan where pieces of mini Napa cabbage are laid out and water is poured in. (8) The marinated pork is placed directly on top of the cabbage, and cilantro stems are added before the chef, a man in a pink shirt, covers the pan with a glass lid. (9) After cooking, the pork is shown being seared in a flat pan to caramelize the glaze, followed by the chef slicing the cooked meat on a wooden board. (10) The final shots return to the completed dish, showing the chef brushing maltose syrup over the pork for a final shine.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a cheerful, mid-tempo acoustic guitar melody accompanied by a bright glockenspiel accent. A friendly male narrator introduces the dish with high energy. (2) As the narration transitions into listing ingredients, the speaker's rate increases, maintaining a clear and articulated broadcasting quality. The background music remains constant in volume and tempo. (3) Subtle Foley-style sounds of liquid pouring and hands rubbing against the meat are audible under the narration. (4) A metallic click and a soft thud occur when the pan lid is placed on the stove. The narrator explains the cooking time with a confident tone. (5) A light sizzling sound emerges during the searing phase, accompanied by a slight swell in the music's high frequencies. (6) The narrator concludes with a satisfied, rising intonation as the final dish is presented, and the music fades out with a final guitar strum.
